name: Haunts of Utrebant
_source: Monster Sheet (2 pages), AI/BP/Routine card sheet, Signature card — owner scans 2026-11-15 (readings owner-confirmed). Clash Setup: Sunken Kingdom Codex (pending)

footprint.rear: the single cell directly behind (R on the sheet diagram)

basicAbilities.name: Superior Bypass
basicAbilities.rule: Rulebook p.80: may move through other miniatures and enter/end on Obstacle spaces; cannot end voluntary movement on another miniature.

basicAbilities.name: Interval Spawn
basicAbilities.rule: Owner 2026-11-15: spawns at the interval its Trait sets — Ethereal Unity (3 tokens → 3 Haunts at Fool's deck coordinates).

traits.name: Intangible
traits.text: Haunts of Utrebant ignore Terrain tiles for the purposes of both voluntary and involuntary movement, and Line of Sight.

traits.name: Ethereal Unity
traits.text:
! If any effect during the Delve instructed you to Escalate the BP deck, ignore that effect.

Each time a Haunt of Utrebant is removed from the Board, place a Generic token on this Trait. After you finish resolving the current action, if there are 3 or more tokens on this Trait, discard all tokens and Spawn three new Haunts of Utrebant. Draw three cards from the top of the Fool’s deck, and place new Haunts on the Board according to coordinates on the cards. If a Haunt were to Spawn on a space occupied by a Knight, instead place it on an unoccupied adjacent space. Assign Activation tokens starting from the left of the Mob track.

For every token on the Ethereal Unity Trait, all Haunts of Utrebant currently on the Clash Board gain the following bonuses:
1 token: +1 To Hit [To Hit].
2 tokens: All Attacks cause an additional -1 [Vigor] loss.
The effects of this Trait can stack.

traits.name: Spectral Step
traits.text:
Certain Zone Attacks include specially designated spaces on their diagrams. After performing a Zone Attack, the attacking Haunt will appear on that space.

If a Haunt were to appear on a space occupied by a Knight as a result of this Trait, that Knight suffers Unavoidable Knockback 3 and Crash. If a Haunt were to appear beyond a Board Edge, it appears adjacent to that Board Edge instead.

traits.name: Obscured Vision
traits.text: All Knights lose -2 Precision [Precision] when adjacent to a Ruined Wall Terrain tile.

traits.name: The Grim Gift
traits.text: During AI Escalation, always Escalate the lowest AI card from the AI deck or discard pile (prioritize the deck). This Trait takes precedence over regular Escalation rules.

traits.name: Revenge Served Ghastly Cold
traits.text: When you Spawn new Haunts of Utrebant, the leftmost Haunt performs Signature. Ignore during the first Monster Round.

traits.name: No Mercy
traits.text: Zone sizes of all Zone Judgments change from 1 to 2, and diagrams of all Zone Attacks increase in size as indicated by the yellow colored spaces on the diagram. If a Haunt of Utrebant moves onto a space occupied by a Knight at the end of a Zone Attack, that Knight dies!

clashSetup._source: Sunken Kingdom Codex p.48–49 (Haunts of Utrebant Clash) — owner PDF 2026-11-15
steps: Monster Positioning: Put numbered base rings on all Haunt of Utrebant miniatures. Randomly place Haunt of Utrebant miniatures numbered 1–3 on the spaces designated on the diagram. Note the facing direction indicated by the arrows. Then, place 3 BP 1 cards face down in a random order on spaces 1–3 on the Mob track.
Additional Setup: Place the Fool's deck near the Monster Sheet. Follow additional Clash Setup instructions introduced by Traits (if any).
Aftermath Loot: Victorious Search — Clash Scavenge 1 and Scavenge 3; Forlorn Search — Scavenge 3.
notes: 지형 칸 위치 — 소유자 확인 2026-11-15

rulings: Ethereal Unity "removed from the Board" = a Haunt dies (its BP goes to the Wound Stack) (소유자 확인 2026-11-15)

Ethereal Unity Spawn: three lowest-level BPs from the Escalation decks on the leftmost empty Mob-track spaces; a coordinate held by a Knight or another Haunt → an unoccupied adjacent space (ties: player) (소유자 확인 2026-11-15)

Ethereal Unity "Assign Activation tokens starting from the left of the Mob track": all Activation tokens are re-dealt one per Mob from the leftmost, keeping their spent/unspent state (소유자 확인 2026-11-15)
Ethereal Unity bonuses stack: 1+ token → +1 To Hit, 2 tokens → +1 To Hit and +1 Vigor loss on every Haunt Attack

Zone Attack with MOVE: the Haunt moves toward the Target until adjacent, turns to face it, then the card diagram (rotated to its facing) gives the Zone; Spectral Step moves it to the marked space after the After Attack. When several movement paths are possible the player picks (소유자 확인 2026-11-15)
Judgement effect lines without "If hit" (e.g. "Gain the Dread Condition card") still need a hit: a Full Evade cancels every effect line (소유자 확인 2026-11-15, 이전 해석 정정)
Zone Judgement: the Target plus every Knight in Zone 1 (No Mercy: Zone 2) around it are judged
Intangible: Haunts path through Terrain and miniatures (Superior Bypass) and ignore Terrain for Line of Sight; they still cannot end a move on another miniature
Gordon: every Monster Attack made by a Haunt within Zone 2 of revealed Gordon causes an additional -2 Vigor [해석]
Woolf: a Knight within Zone 2 of revealed Woolf can only attack Woolf
Amelie: every Gated Effect on AI cards resolves regardless of Heat
Peter "Gain +1 Curse": Curse is shared — the party Curse level +1 (소유자 확인 2026-11-15)
Spectral Step onto a Knight: the Knight is knocked back 3 in a direction the player chooses (소유자 확인 2026-11-15)
Percy wound: a 1x2 Swamp tile on the dead Haunt's space plus an adjacent space without Terrain (player picks)
The Unremarkable One Critical "see 8915": story reference — logged only
